_why: DRYDOCK's plan (NIGHT15 U3-28.2, MAP-DESIGN.md section 4): the one source of numbers for the plan SVG (Tools/map-plan-svg.cjs -> Logs/shots/n15-plan.png) and the greybox build script (Assets/Editor/Maps/Build_drydock.cs -> Design/maps/drydock.json). Web coordinates: x east, y up, z SOUTH (north is -z; a yaw of 0 faces north, -z); metres. Every distance is sized from the movement numbers in MAP-DESIGN.md section 1 (config keys cited there). New design (GG, 2026-10-05: a map overhaul), so Unity-side (CLAUDE.md rule 5); D-59 (the map's identity) stays GG's.
name: DRYDOCK
notes: built: the zones the NIGHT15 greybox builds; the rest are drawn on the plan only (night 2).
Unbuilt areas have NO floor tonight (no nav nodes); walls close the built footprint (wall height 14, barrier 14..40 above).
ramps: from = the low end's centre (x, z), to = the high end's centre, width across, rise = the high end's height; the build script turns each into a WedgeSpec.
zone rects are [x0, z0, x1, z1] at y 0..40 (data.zones[i].boxes); boundary walls straddle the zone lines (2 m thick).

U3-28.6 (the greybox build's plan checks, DrydockPlan.Check): three numbers fixed: the high spawn [-57, 10, 16] is now [-57, 8, 16] (the south-row slab at x -58..-56 is 8 m tall: it floated 2 m); THE CROW'S NEST [0, 30, 0] is now [0, 30, -2] (it stood inside the mast); the BOUNCER's facing [-1, 0] is now [1, 0] (its buy point stood inside the hull).

U3-28.6 (the lead's design call): the wall guns and perks are ported ones (Loadout.Fires, Perks.Ported), so each zone has a working wall buy and perk tonight: gangway shotgun (THUNDERCLAP 750) and mend, cradle rocket (COMET 2000), ribs nailgun (STITCHER 1250), slipway rail (LONGWAVE 3000); the design's RATTLER, BOUNCER, DISCUS and STEADY were not ported.

U3-28.6 (the lead's calls on the greybox's findings): the exfil radio's yaw 0 -> pi (it faced the cliff wall 2 m away); the slipway deck's west face x 24 -> 23 (it meets the cradle | slipway wall; the 2 m pocket in front of it is gone); LAUNCH RAIL: the kicker's rise 1.5 -> 2.0 and the platform (and its relay) 2.5 -> 3.0 m, over a well-timed standing double jump (~2.7 m by formula, which RIVAL's graph flew onto the 2.5 m platform) and under a slide-jump off the 2.0 m lip (~3.41 m).
